evidence.text: Finally, we employ the Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) [Rubner et al., 2000] to assess the continuity of crystal graphs, demonstrating that WPDD crystal graphs constructed using only Euclidean distances maintain continuity and general completeness under slight atomic position perturbations, providing a more accurate depiction of actual crystal structures.
